cohort.include: split in train/test; frequency > 900; interictal == true; length >= 62; dataset != Multicenter
cohort.channel_include: channels.tsv good == 1 and soz exactly 0 or 1 and exact EDF name present

preprocessing.resampling: MNE anti-aliased full-record resample after notch; channel-separable
preprocessing.train_segments_per_edf: Omni extract_random_samples count/start algorithm, max 5; deterministic per-EDF SHA256-derived RNG seed; shared starts across channels for synchronous A1 channel attention
preprocessing.test_segments_per_edf: Omni extract_uniform_samples; every complete nonoverlapping 60-s segment after edge exclusion

architecture.name: A1_OMNI_INTERICTAL
architecture.source: exact historical NeuroEZCModel R0 backbone; all auxiliary mechanisms off

optimization.train_sampling: uniform patient; per epoch one deterministic 60-s segment per available EDF, rotating across frozen five train-side segments
optimization.inner_validation: deterministic dataset/SOZ-presence stratified patient 80/20 split, seed 42; no test patient
optimization.selection: maximum patient-equal EZ average precision on inner validation, earlier epoch on ties
optimization.final_fit: reinitialize and fit all official train patients for selected number of epochs using same optimizer and patient-equal objective
optimization.normalization: exact historical A1 pooled feature mean/std, fit on corresponding training patients only
